title: Evidence Quality Check
description: Run the replay-safe SCRUM-215 evidence-quality decision against terminal exact-head CI evidence and a schema-valid, read-only independent-review receipt bound to the same task, repository, PR, head SHA and scope hash. Missing, stale, malformed, projection-only, contradictory or mismatched evidence fails closed; PASS is evidence only and grants no G4, G5 or G6 authority.
